facts.fact: The Kenya Meteorological Department says the African Union Commission, under ClimSA, installed and upgraded PUMA 2025 and ClimSA stations at KMD in August 2024, able to capture Meteosat Third Generation data.

systems.owner: Kenya Meteorological Department with the AUC and EUMETSAT

note: Warnings are only stated as what the system is vital for, not as issued.
